name: Morning market lane
desc: Busy morning market lane with striped awnings, bunting, big patterned umbrellas, baskets of vegetables, a fish tray and hanging bananas

name: Rooftop at night
desc: Rooftop at night with a parapet, black water tanks, a clothesline with a sari, potted plants, a kite stuck on a TV aerial, and the city lights and moon beyond

name: Railway platform
desc: Small-town railway platform under an iron canopy with green pillars, a hanging clock, a yellow station name board, a bench, tracks and a green train carriage

name: Monsoon flood street
desc: Flooded street in monsoon rain with dark scalloped clouds, buildings with lit windows, a half-submerged rickshaw wheel and a paper boat floating

name: The courtyard
desc: Sunny courtyard of an old house with a brick well, green doors, drying saris on a line, a string cot, potted plants and a white floor-art circle on the red floor

name: The kitchen
desc: Home kitchen with teal tiles, a shelf of steel plates and pots, a grilled window, a two-burner stove with a pressure cooker, spice jars, hanging ladles and a teal fridge

name: The living room
desc: Old-fashioned living room with a ceiling fan, a green-shuttered window, framed family photos, a wall clock and calendar, a wooden sofa with red cushions and white lace covers, a radio, a TV cabinet and a patterned floor

name: The classroom
desc: School classroom with a green chalkboard showing Bangla letters and a sum, a teacher's desk with a globe and books, sunny windows, a ceiling fan, a clock and rows of wooden benches

name: River at dawn
desc: River at dawn with a soft pink sky, the sun just rising, a misty far shore with palm silhouettes, sailing boats and birds

name: Village at noon
desc: Village at noon with a blue sky, bright sun, a dark tree line, thatched huts, coconut palms, a winding dirt path, a small pond and green paddy rows

name: Mangrove night
desc: Mangrove forest at night with a pale moon reflected in dark water, arching roots, fireflies and two glowing eyes in the shadows

name: Haunted banyan grove
desc: Haunted banyan grove under a huge full moon, a giant black banyan with hanging roots, bands of fog, bats, a broken swing and a glowing lantern on the ground

name: Tuli’s room
desc: Tuli's bedroom studio with a window and sun beam, a pinboard of sketches under fairy lights, a desk with a lamp and sketchbooks, a bed with a ripple-pattern quilt, red headphones and a helmet on the floor

name: Ma & Baba’s bedroom
desc: Parents' bedroom with a carved wooden bed under a mosquito net, a dressing table with a round mirror, a steel cupboard, a ceiling fan, a calendar and slippers on the floor

name: The newlyweds’ flat
desc: Modern small apartment with a big window onto city towers, a grey sofa with cushions, a work desk with a laptop, a baking counter with a mixer, a cake stand and flour bags, plants and a wall AC

name: Inside the mud hut
desc: Inside a village mud hut: thatch ceiling, mud walls with white floor-art bands, a small window with a beam of light, a clay stove and pots, a woven floor mat, a hanging lantern and a blue tin trunk

name: Mansion grand hall
desc: Grand hall of the old mansion with deep red damask walls, tall arched windows with green drapes, a golden chandelier, two ancestor portraits with big mustaches, a carved chair, a ring light and a black and white checked floor with cobwebs in the corners

name: Prof. Ghontu’s lab
desc: Professor Ghontu's cluttered lab with pipes on the ceiling, a chalkboard of formulas, shelves of glowing bubbling jars, a big gear machine with a coil, lever and sparks, a workbench and a spiral-pattern rug

name: Gyani’s tree library
desc: Secret library inside the hollow banyan trunk with curved wooden walls showing tree rings, shelves of colourful books, hanging roots, lanterns, a round door open to the moonlit night, a ladder and a stump table with an open book and candle

name: Kalo Megh’s office
desc: Kalo Megh's dark office with hatched walls, a floor-to-ceiling window onto the night city under a red moon, a high-backed chair facing away, a black desk with a red lamp, a model of the town with a grey paved river, a crow on a perch and a framed blueprint

name: Police station — outside
desc: Nandanpur police station: an old red-brick colonial building with a white cornice, an arched verandah, a blue sign board, barred windows, a notice board of posters, a banyan tree with a bench, and a blue police jeep with a red roof light parked on the dusty yard

name: Police station — inside
desc: Inside the police station: cream walls with a green lower half, a ceiling fan, a wall clock, a pinboard of wanted posters with question marks, a big wooden duty desk with an open register, a black rotary phone, a rubber stamp and a clay tea cup, piles of files tied with red tape, a grey steel cupboard, and a barred lock-up with a bench

name: Hospital — outside
desc: Nandanpur Sadar Hospital: a three-storey white building with teal bands, rows of windows, a big teal plus sign in a circle on the roof, a green sign board in Bangla, an entrance canopy with a ramp, a white ambulance with a teal stripe, a little tea stall with a kettle under a striped awning, and coconut palms

name: Doctor’s chamber
desc: Doctor’s chamber in the hospital: pale teal walls, a Bangla letter eye chart, a glowing x-ray light box showing a fish skeleton, a window with a sunbeam, a medicine shelf of coloured bottles, a desk with a prescription pad, a stethoscope and a blood-pressure machine, two chairs, and an examination bed with a white sheet behind a plus-patterned curtain on a rail

name: Front gate
desc: Front of Nandanpur High School: a long yellow two-storey colonial building with green arched shutters, a terracotta parapet and a clock gable, a white boundary wall with an iron gate under a blue arch sign, a red-flowering flame tree, bicycles leaning on the wall and a fuchka cart with a glass box of puris at the gate

name: Playground
desc: School playground: green field with white chalk lines, a football goal with a net, a football, a terracotta assembly platform with a microphone, a big banyan tree with a plank swing and aerial roots, the yellow back of the school with green shutters, and a boundary wall painted with an orange fish mural

name: Classroom
desc: Classroom: cream walls with a teal lower band and a red-oxide floor, a big green chalkboard in a wooden frame with a Bangla sum, letters and a chalk fish doodle, green shuttered windows with sunlight, a ceiling fan, a wall clock, the teacher’s table with an attendance register, a chalk box and a globe, and two rows of wooden desks and benches with schoolbags

name: Corridor
desc: School corridor seen through a row of yellow arches: classroom doors marked Class 5 and Class 6, a notice board with pinned papers, the brass school gong with its mallet hanging from a hook, a water filter with a steel cup on a chain, a green dado and a red-oxide floor with arch-shaped patches of sunlight

name: Science lab
desc: School science lab: a black-topped wooden lab bench with cupboards and a curved tap, a Bunsen burner with a blue flame, a rack of coloured test tubes, a microscope, a glowing green flask, a chart of coloured element squares, shelves of jars including a pickled fish and a fish skeleton, and a window

name: Teachers’ room
desc: Teachers’ room: a long table with a green cloth piled with exam copies tied in red string, a red pen, clay tea cups and a brass call bell, a class routine chart on the wall, a wall clock, a shelf of gold trophies, a wooden almirah, a black umbrella on a hook, a ceiling fan and a red-oxide floor

name: Chowdhury Mansion
desc: Crumbling old mansion with white pillars, green arched shutters, a semicircle fanlight over the door and a sapling growing from the roof

name: The Sen House
desc: Narrow two-storey pale blue family house with green shutters, a balcony with laundry and a black water tank on the roof

name: Village Mud Hut
desc: Village mud hut with a golden thatched roof, white floor-art motifs on the wall, bamboo posts, a banana plant and a haystack

name: Modern Apartment Block
desc: Four-storey dusty pink apartment block at dusk with lit windows, air conditioners, balconies with plants and water tanks and a satellite dish on the roof

name: Corner Tea Stall
desc: Corner tea stall with a corrugated tin roof, a red tea sign, a kettle on a clay stove, glass jars, hanging snack packets, a light bulb and a wooden bench

name: River Ghat & Pavilion
desc: Riverside steps leading into the water at sunset, a small arched pavilion with a curved roof, and a wooden country boat tied up

name: Sen kitchen at midnight (from the Short)
desc: The Sen family kitchen with the big fridge, night light.

name: Stairwell to the roof (from the Short)
desc: Low steps, full railings and the roof door at the top.

name: Title card
desc: Big title text on a Rongpat pattern. Write the title in the Subtitle column; use | for a second line.
